verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documents the core agent flow. Agents can query available slots (including by username and event slug, with the original booking excluded for rescheduling), create bookings through a public endpoint built for agents, and reschedule accepted or pending bookings. The official hosted MCP server at mcp.cal.com uses OAuth and lets clients "manage bookings" in natural language. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented cancel endpoint or MCP cancel tool (cancellation appears only as a BOOKING_CANCELLED webhook trigger and the general "manage bookings" wording), and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.
